blocks.x: I have so many more questions to ask you, JC, but I think today we'll call it quits and we'll pick up the pieces the next time.
I think that we could probably go
on talking for about two hours straight, but time is running out for me today.
But I'll be back, and I can't wait.
I will as soon as you come.
And you know, any little old anecdotes that you want to share with all these people at the Smithsonian, you know, we've got to dig up.
All right, so long for now.
